questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Unit, integration, and documentation tests”?
options: cargo test runs both #[test] functions and eligible rustdoc examples.
Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
Obtain the installer from rust-lang.org and install native prerequisites only for the target you need.
Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
questions.answer: cargo test runs both #[test] functions and eligible rustdoc examples.
questions.explanation:
cargo test runs both #[test] functions and eligible rustdoc examples.
Why: Unit tests can check private module behavior; integration tests exercise a crate's public API as a consumer would. Documentation tests execute examples alongside docs and catch stale snippets. Test both successful and boundary/error cases; `cargo test` runs the suite.
